from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
import numpy as np
smi='CCCCOC(=O)N'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
print('canonical SMILES:', Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
print('formula:', Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m) if hasattr(Chem,'rdMolDescriptors') else 'butyl carbamate')
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=17
if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)!=0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
conf=m.GetConformer()
atoms=[(a.GetSymbol(),tuple(conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()))) for a in m.GetAtoms()]
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms, basis='6-31g*', charge=0, spin=0, verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol); calc.xc='B3LYP'; calc.conv_tol=1e-9; calc.max_cycle=150
energy=calc.kernel()
if not calc.converged: raise RuntimeError('SCF did not converge')
occ=calc.mo_occ
lumo_idx=np.where(occ<1e-8)[0][0]
print('method: B3LYP/6-31G* single-point on RDKit MMFF-optimized conformer')
print('SCF energy (Ha):', float(energy))
print('LUMO orbital index:', int(lumo_idx))
